# clio triple query

match subject/predicate/object patterns

## Usage

```
clio triple query [SUBJECT [PREDICATE [OBJECT]]] [--subject S] [--predicate P] [--object O] [--as-of TS] [--time-axis valid|transaction] [--limit N] [--offset N] [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SUBJECT` | no | Subject pattern to match; omit it to match any subject. |
| `PREDICATE` | no | Predicate pattern to match; omit it to match any predicate. |
| `OBJECT` | no | Object pattern to match; omit it to match any object. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--subject S` | text |  | `triple_query_call` sets the pattern. |
| `--predicate P` | text |  | `triple_query_call` sets the pattern. |
| `--object O` | text |  | `triple_query_call` sets the pattern. |
| `--as-of TS` | text |  | Sets the reference `as_of` timestamp. |
| `--time-axis valid\|transaction` | enum: valid, transaction | `valid` | `cli_read_belief` validates `valid` or `transaction`, and the tool defaults it to `valid`. |
| `--limit N` | uint | `50` | Caps the result page; defaults to 50 when omitted; a limit above 200 is lowered to 200. |
| `--offset N` | uint | `0` | Skips this many leading results; the tool defaults it to 0 when omitted. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio triple query itm-sample-1 related itm-sample-2 --db ./memory.db
```

one subject term
```
clio triple query itm-sample-1
```

```
clio triple query --as-of 2026-01-01 -o json
```
